abstract_sentences.text: Training LLM agents for complex multi-turn decision-making tasks requires extensive exploration within their environment, with reinforcement learning (RL) as a natural way.

evidence.anchor: requires extensive exploration within their environment

abstract_sentences.text: However, the open-source community currently lacks a unified RL framework capable of training agents from scratch across diverse and realistic environments.
abstract_sentences.transition_to_next: 从对象转入开源框架缺口。

abstract_sentences.text: To bridge this gap, we introduce AgentGym-RL, a modular and decoupled framework specifically designed for RL-based agent in multi-turn decision-making tasks.
abstract_sentences.transition_to_next: 用框架回答统一基础设施缺口。

evidence.anchor: introduce AgentGym-RL, a modular and decoupled framework

abstract_sentences.text: It offers high flexibility and extensibility, supports mainstream RL algorithms, and spans a broad range of real-world scenarios.
To effectively train agents for challenging tasks, we argue that they are required to expand external interactions with the environment, rather than relying solely on internal reasoning.

evidence.anchor: expand external interactions with the environment

abstract_sentences.text: Nevertheless, training agents for long-horizon interaction with vanilla methods often faces challenges like training instability.
abstract_sentences.transition_to_next: 为方法建立稳定性障碍。

evidence.anchor: often faces challenges like training instability

abstract_sentences.text: To this end, we propose ScalingInter-RL, a staged training approach for stable long-horizon RL training.
It starts with short-horizon interaction to establish foundational policies and progressively expands them to encourage deeper exploration.

Extensive experiments show that agents trained with our method achieve performance on par with—or even surpass—commercial counterparts like OpenAI o3 and Gemini-2.5-Pro across 27 tasks in diverse environments.
We share key insights and release the full framework, including code and datasets, to empower the community in building the next generation of intelligent agents.

evidence.anchor: release the full framework, including code and datasets

abstract_sentences.text: Our framework is available at https://github.com/WooooDyy/AgentGym-RL.

final_judgment.single_storyline: 复杂 agent task 需要更多外部 interaction；直接放宽 horizon 会使 RL 不稳定；AgentGym-RL 提供多环境底座，ScalingInter-RL 以 staged horizon 连接可训练性和探索深度。[PDF p.6, §4, “progressive horizon-scaling strategy”; basis=explicit]
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留三模块架构、POMDP/PG 目标、horizon schedule、训练动态、五场景总体图、Deep Search 主表、test-time scaling、算法比较、消融和效率图。[PDF pp.3–9, §§2–6, Figures 2–8 / Tables 1–4; basis=layout_observation]
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 附录承载四环境完整表、环境级数据/超参数、hardware、grad-norm instability 与成功/失败轨迹；正文可理解提案，却无法独立复现或核验全部 task 异质性。[PDF pp.24–32, Appendices D–F; basis=interpretation]
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 4 同页并置 fixed-short ceiling、fixed-long collapse 与 progressive schedule，用一个视觉对象完成问题定义、方法必要性和预期动态。[PDF p.5, Figure 4, “Training dynamics”; basis=interpretation]
final_judgment.largest_gap: external-interaction 与 parameter/internal-reasoning scaling 的比较缺 compute-matched 同模型控制；稳定性缺多 seed 与核心 curriculum removal；Figure 14 caption 还与图内任务冲突。[PDF p.5, Figure 5; PDF p.35, Figure 14; basis=interpretation/layout_observation]
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 训练方法若源自可观测 failure mode，正文应并置失败基线、受限但稳定基线和方法曲线，使一张图同时承担问题定义与方法必要性。[PDF p.5, Figure 4; basis=interpretation]
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该模式适合训练动态可观测且基线可匹配的优化方法；数据、模型家族或系统预算不匹配时仍需额外控制和重复实验。[PDF p.7, §5.2, “post-training and inference-time compute”; basis=interpretation]
